subject.title: fix: guard JSON.parse calls against malformed external responses

question: Should this PR own the OpenRouter malformed-SSE guard, with the adjacent OpenRouter buffer-cap PR rebased around it, or should the OpenRouter hunk be split out before merge?
rationale: Both branches edit the same OpenRouter parser, and automation cannot choose the canonical sequencing without risking review churn or dropped parser behavior.

options.title: Keep This PR Canonical
options.body: Land this multi-surface JSON parse guard and require the OpenRouter buffer-cap PR to rebase while preserving the malformed-frame skip.

options.title: Split OpenRouter Out
options.body: Narrow this PR to docs search and Claude MCP config if maintainers want the OpenRouter buffer-cap branch to own all OpenRouter parser changes.

options.title: Pause For OpenRouter First
options.body: Wait for the buffer-cap PR to land first, then rebase this PR and retain only the remaining parse guards that still apply.

recommendation.title: Keep This PR Canonical
recommendation.body: Land this multi-surface JSON parse guard and require the OpenRouter buffer-cap PR to rebase while preserving the malformed-frame skip.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has feature history across docs search, music generation, and bundle MCP, making him the best available owner for this branch-sequencing choice.
